name: TGC helper unprotected buy/sell entry points
summary: The unverified TGC helper exposes unauthenticated entry points (selectors 0x836aefb0 and 0xfd5a466f) that move the helper's TGC and USDT through the pair, which the attacker drove from inside a PancakeSwap swap callback.
